jobs_results.title: Senior Manager, Data Analytics - Marketing
jobs_results.description:
Senior Manager, Data Analytics - Marketing

 

Your mission in the Marketing team: 

At TouchTunes, your work matters, this role goes beyond reporting: it owns the measurement of our consumer marketing and loyalty programs and turns that measurement into clear, actionable insight that shapes decisions. Ultimately this person would help unlock the power of our data as we accelerate growth.

Your day-to-day:  
                

Define and lead a scalable marketing analytics roadmap/strategy for marketing and loyalty programs.Partner with Marketing and Finance to set and forecast weekly marketing goals that connect to the commercial business plan, such as total new purchasers, new purchasers from paid, and incremental plays from lifecycle, and build the tracking to measure performance against them.Own the measurement and insight narrative for consumer marketing and loyalty programs: Play Challenges, Special Offers, Team Rewards, and lifecycle campaigns across all loyalty tiers.Act as the strategic analytical partner to Marketing: translate business questions and goals into measurement frameworks, and turn results into clear recommendations that drive decisions, not just dashboards.Automate recurring campaign and lifecycle reporting, applying AI and modern tooling (for example, through Braze, our experimentation stack, and LLM-based workflows) so effort shifts from manual reporting to insight and strategy.Build and maintain lifecycle and retention analysis, including churn modeling and segmentation, and surface the highest-value opportunities to grow and retain our most valuable users. 

Your profile:

jobs_results.description: **Data Analytics Program Manager** **Role Overview** A large e-commerce and logistics client is looking for adata-first program operator to own the analytics backbone of a fast-scalingenergy and power planning function. This person manages large, complex datasetsacross hundreds to thousands of active sites in various stages of planning, duediligence, capital approval, and construction -- translating raw data intodecisions and building the tracking infrastructure the team runs on. This is not a traditional program manager role. The coreskillset is data -- querying it, modeling it, centralizing it, and making itactionable. Strong operational discipline ensures thatanalytical outputs actually drive cross-functional alignment, risk visibility,and on-time delivery across PMO, Finance, Capital Management, Pre-Construction,and Construction stakeholders. **What You'll Do** + Own and maintain centralized trackers spanning the full site lifecycle -- from demand forecasting and site selection through power due diligence, capital approval, utility engagement, and construction delivery -- across a portfolio of hundreds to thousands of locations simultaneously + Build and manage data models that integrate inputs from multiple internal and third-party sources into a single, reliable source of truth for portfolio health, risk, cost, and timeline status + Design and stand up risk tracking frameworks that embed site-level due diligence outputs directly into downstream PMO and capital workflows, closing handoff gaps between site selection and delivery teams + Produce executive-level reporting and dashboards that surface portfolio risk, cost variance, milestone status, and coverage gaps in real time + Identify data gaps, ownership ambiguities, and process breakdowns across stakeholder groups and build the mechanisms to fix them -- trackers, playbooks, operating rhythms, and escalation frameworks + Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure utility infrastructure and interconnect costs flow accurately into capital approval budgets + Drive automation opportunities across high-frequency data workflows and define requirements for tooling improvements **What You'll Need** + 5+ years in a data analyst or data-heavy program management role managing large, multi-variable datasets across complex portfolios + PMP certification or equivalent -- used to structure ambiguity, not just manage schedules + Advanced Excel/Sheets and hands-on BI tool experience (Tableau, Power BI, Quicksight, or similar) + SQL proficiency; Python a strong plus + Proven ability to build centralized tracking and reporting infrastructure from scratch across multiple stakeholder groups + Experience in capital-intensive industries -- energy, utilities, infrastructure, real estate, or logistics strongly preferred + Demonstrated ability to work backward from a messy data landscape and build clean, scalable systems that others depend on CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate's education, training, and experience.
